title: Add an In Planning status for implementation readiness
description: Add a distinct workflow status for work that is still being planned. Reserve todo for work the owner considers ready to implement, and make sure agent guidance explains the transition.
why: Agents currently use todo as their ready-to-start status, while incomplete blueprints are only warnings. Work still being planned needs a visible state excluded from plantool next.

acceptance.text: New projects start newly created tickets in in_planning
todo is reserved for planned implementation work
plantool next and claim exclude in_planning tickets
existing projects can add the status explicitly
CLI, MCP, UI and agent documentation explain the workflow.

todos.text: Implement the status and upgrade path
verify with the full check suite

outcome.summary: Added in_planning status, migration command, readiness gating, and agent documentation for 0.1.1.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check (121 passed, 1 skipped); plantool check (0 warnings); node --check src/ui.js; git diff --check.
